name: Telephone outlet plan symbol
summary: Plan symbol for a telephone outlet where a voice service is terminated for a handset or device.
description: Telephone outlets are drawn as a triangle or outlet shape tagged T or TP. In modern buildings, voice is usually carried on structured cabling, so the telephone outlet may simply be a data outlet assigned to voice, but legends still keep a separate mark for analogue lines, lift phones and alarm diallers.

Analogue lines remain common for lifts, emergency phones and some alarm communicators. The plan symbol tells the installer that a dedicated voice pair must reach this point. The symbol does not show whether the line is analogue, digital or VoIP.
readingNotes: Check whether a dedicated analogue line is required.
Match to the voice cabling schedule.
distinction: A telephone set symbol represents the handset itself; the outlet is the wall termination.
